newsitem.title: USA: Coca-Cola FEMSA rises in moderate trade.
newsitem.headline: Coca-Cola FEMSA rises in moderate trade.

text.p: Mexican bottler Coca-Cola FEMSA SA rose sharply Friday but the stock later eased off its intraday high.

The shares were up 2-11/16 to 54-5/16 in early afternoon, above a 12-month closing high of 52. They had hit a high of 55-3/4 before easing, and were briefly among the percentage gain leaders on the New York Stock Exchange.
Traders said they did not know why Coca-Cola FEMSA had risen. "There is nothing special and there's no news about it," one said.
Volume was 92,200 shares, above the average daily level of 79,670.
The shares have gone up steadily in recent weeks, rising from 35 on April 29.
